objective: Fix production OTA RC pinned V28 package.json raw-Git-blob newline mismatch without relaxing native/ABI/dependency security or changing app behavior. Add read-only exact production native baseline preflight before owner-waived device-check release.

chosenApproach: For one `package.json` pinned source comparison, call execFileSync('git',['show',...],{encoding:'utf8'}) to preserve raw bytes rather than generic git() helper that .trim()s. Keep strict pinned SHA, native package delta, plugin exact-line, ABI config, stage identity, served production EAS manifest and season2 embargo checks. Add a negative newline regression and an entirely nonpublishing production baseline QA.
selectionRationale: Root-cause is accidental normalization of signed Git blob, not native package drift. Raw byte reading is strictly more accurate than forgiving whitespace or weakening digest assertions.
